title: Party Roles and Separation of Duties
note: Five roles and six operations. The separation is the point: a HumanPrincipal issues authority but cannot Notarize, and a NotaryService attests decisions but cannot issue authority. Collapsing the two would let one party both grant a permission and vouch for it, destroying the third-party verifiability the protocol exists to provide. ChannelAdapter is least-privileged — it may only Transport.
